readings.span:
On the surface, it simply describes a scene:

> A red wheelbarrow, wet from rain, sits beside some white chickens.
farm work or daily life depends on simple tools
beauty and meaning depend on noticing ordinary things
the poem itself depends on this image
reality depends on small, concrete details
So the poem is basically saying: **a humble, ordinary scene can carry deep significance if we truly look at it.**
